sources.title: OpenStreetMap country boundary relations and their shared ways

method: Complete shared non-maritime OSM boundary arcs replace mismatched exterior runs, using a single Tumen tripoint. Interior subdivision boundaries and coasts outside the repair remain intact. The old Natural Earth junction is not used as a detailed geometry anchor. Border strokes are stored once and stay fully visible at every zoom. Display policy requested by the atlas owner suppresses all 22 small river enclaves: their separate outlines and Korean fill are removed, and the enclosing Chinese display region fills the cutouts. Original OSM island geometry and attribution remain separately retained; this is cartographic generalization, not a change to the source border claim.

islands.display: Suppressed at the user request: no separate island border or Korean overlay; enclosing Chinese display fills the cutout.
